properties.name: Bhasar Lake
properties.description: Bhasar Lake is a classic example of human efforts towards water preservation. The slope of the meadow is complemented with rock-concrete to ensure the snow melt and rain water remain available for long.

properties.name: Rai Lake
properties.description: Located near Bhasar Lake, this lake is quite big and collects natural water from rainfall and snow melt.

properties.name: Jaral Tal
properties.description: There are two lakes present out of which one is quite large. The water is fed from season rainfall and snow melt.

properties.name: Manjhyaar Tal
properties.description: Manjhyaar Tal is a beautiful natural water lake that can be visited throughout the year. There are many paths to reach the lake but the easiest one is from Marwari village.

properties.name: Kanatal
properties.description: Perched at an altitude of 2400m, Kanatal is a paradise for people who are looking for solace from hustle-bustle. There are multiples ways to reach Kanatal but the easiest one is 3.5 kms trek from Marwari village.

properties.name: Bharnala Tal
properties.description: A picturesque lake near Barsu village that adorns a temple of Naag Devta and commands astonishing views of Srikantha, Jaonli and Gangotri peaks.

properties.name: Gantachali Lake
properties.description: A man-made lake to conserve rainwater that is starting point for a trek to Ghantakarn Temple.

properties.name: Kaplas Kund
properties.description: The lake is popularly known as Kailash Kund and is adobe of Vasuki Naag. Every year, a fair and yatra is organised from Bhaderwah during Janmastami.

properties.name: Rishi Pishi Dal
properties.description: A group of two-three small lakes situated below Kailash Kund.

properties.name: Dodi Tal
properties.description: A freshwater lake that is considered source of Assi Ganga river and is home to trout fish.

properties.name: Darwa Lake
properties.description: A high altitude lake located near Darwa Pass commanding excellent view of Bandarpoonch peaks.

properties.name: Kanatal
properties.description: A small lake surrounded by apple orchards.

properties.name: Kaina Tal
properties.description: A small lake near Kaina Danda used to store rainwater and is a source of drinking water for cattle.

properties.name: Nausiri Tal
properties.description: A small lake on Nausiri Danda near Kota village used to store rainwater and is a source of drinking water for the cattle.

properties.name: Achhranda Tal
properties.description: It is known as Aachhari Tal, commands nice view of mountain peaks and is a short hike from Patharkhol.

properties.name: Sama Lake
properties.description: These cluster of lakes on the ridge is an example of efforts put in by locals to store rainwater. The view of sunrise and sunset is mesmerizing.

properties.name: Niharika Lake
properties.description: Nestled in the Aravalli hills close to Gurgaon - Faridabad road, this lake is a pristine beauty. One has to trek through thorny bushes and litle rough terrain to reach the lake.

properties.name: Mangar Lake
properties.description: It is an attractive lake near Mangar village, although one has to pass through thorny bushes and rough roads to reach the lake.

properties.name: Gadisar Lake
properties.description: An artificial lake in Jaisalmer that provides drinking water to the entire city.

properties.name: Karnaji Lake
properties.description: A wetland in Mysuru that is favourite haunt of migratory birds like herons and egrets.

properties.name: Chandragiri Fort Pond
properties.description: A small pond formed due to water seeping in from the upper section of Chandragiri Kota is used for leaisure activities like boating.

properties.name: Khajjiar Lake
properties.description: The lake is set in a huge grassy landscape, with evergreen cedar trees surrounding it from all sides.

properties.name: Parashar Lake
properties.description: A freshwater lake with three storied pagoda-like temple dedicated to the sage Parashar and a floating island.

properties.name: Roopkund
properties.description: A high altitude mystery lake known for the hundreds of human skeletons found at the edge of the lake and the wrath of Nanda Devi

properties.name: Bedni Kund
properties.description: It is a small lake also known as Vaitarani (Bedni Kund) and is situated amidst the lush green alpine meadows of Bedni Bugyal.

properties.name: Kareri Lake
properties.description: This lake is formed by snow melting from the Dhauladhar range and serves as the source of Nyund stream.
